decisionOptions.NO_CHANGE: Keep the current owner surface; no new durable abstraction/projection is justified.
decisionOptions.OWNER_LOCAL: Retain or add the smallest owner-local adapter/projection/default while owner-native truth remains authoritative.
decisionOptions.SHARED_BOUNDARY: Retain a small shared contract/query/reconstruction semantic used by multiple owners, but no independent service/repository or new fact authority.
decisionOptions.RESEARCH_ONLY: Keep the shared problem/candidate inside Computing research or opaque owner references; promotion evidence is insufficient.
decisionOptions.INDEPENDENT_PLATFORM: Create/promote an independently operated shared Ordivon service/repository/platform with its own durable authority/lifecycle.

cases.packet: Host, Harness and Runtime retain independent authoritative histories. Read-only owner exporters plus a bounded Gateway/Selection can reconstruct a complete three-owner trajectory; a formal evaluation consumes a frozen Observation Selection. The projection can be rebuilt and owner correctness/recovery does not depend on it. There is no independent deployment cadence, multi-node pressure, synchronous production dependency or demonstrated need for a streaming/database service.

Evaluation binds an exact System Manifest. Security independently binds EnvironmentIdentity. Both need configuration identity, but Evaluation's schema includes evaluation-only fields and the Security side has not yet passed as a real owner-neutral common record. Opaque immutable owner bindings can already express equality/difference without copying domain payloads.

Harness owns Run/model/tool/token usage; Runtime owns physical Job/Attempt timing and Artifact facts; Security/Finance own domain metrics/costs. Evaluation needs comparable measurements and currently hand-assembles them. Observation already has a measurement projection field. A writable global UsageRecord or metrics database would duplicate authorities; monetary cost has no universal current billing basis.

Runtime already exposes exact Workspace/Job/Artifact/recovery primitives plus a compact runtime.describe affordance in its live owner catalog. Response-loss recovery works through stable clientRequestId, task.list/get/Artifact identity with one dispatch and no duplicate effect. A consumer registration is stale, but owner/deployed capability already exists.

Fresh-Agent control already selects Host task.resume/observe/list/adopt/checkpoint correctly for durable semantic continuity. Host owns Task/checkpoint truth and exposes compact revision-fenced projections. Another facade would not add recovery, authority or semantic capability.

Finance already has a mature internal Agent Context/Surface containing current candidate operations, authority and evidence, but its ordinary command entry defaults to an older historical context. The current Agent surface should remain Finance-owned and must not become a scheduler or plan-selection authority.

Security has many product, evaluation and research entrypoints. A fresh Agent pays mechanical cost distinguishing stable surface taxonomy from experiment apparatus. A read-only classifier can expose constitution/profile/integration/research categories without executing experiments or changing Security authority.

Workstation owns detailed network capability/currentness/effect semantics, but a fresh Agent must reconstruct which bounded observation surface to inspect before selecting any route/effect. A small read-only network surface can expose current mechanically knowable facts while deliberately omitting selector operations, default-route mutation, proxy mutation and TUN effects.
